name: Charles Gee
bio: A long-term resident of George Ives's Adelaide Road household. Cook names him as one of the men who lived there with Ives, Harold Bloodworth and the rest of the household Ives called his 'children'. His nickname is given by Brian Lewis as Wobby or Wubby; the spelling is not yet settled. Nothing else about him - his years, his work, how he came to the house - appears in any source read.
bio_note: Cook (2014), p. 101 glosses his nickname as 'Cubby'; Lewis says this is an error, Cubby being Harold Holt (as Cook 2003, p. 146, has it). Both spellings (Wobby/Wubby) are carried because Lewis's wording was taken down by hand and the spelling awaits his confirmation. Dates: none recorded.
